purpose: Parent actual-byte and inode/directory evidence for frozen beta_capture_audit_v1; no process control, canonical audit or release
api: EvidenceReader(deadline_check); read_bytes(path,cap)->bytes; directory_names(path,cap=256)->list[str]; last_file(path)->actualmetadata or None; report()->serializable acquisitions/observations/unresolved. Caller composes X1-X7 and requires report.unresolved empty before any PASS.
requirements: Strict normalized absolute NOFOLLOW directory walk; NONBLOCK regular one-link leaf; readcap<=16MiB and actualcap+1

Register all raw/open and iterator acquisitions before observation/clock; retain returned descriptors immediately; preserve ambiguous acquisitions/close results; at most one own close; no close by reused-number inference

Record successful read/EOF/fstat result before later deadline checks; keep actual pre/post leaf and directory metadata; originaldeadline never renewed; no hard wall guarantee for synchronous filesystem calls
Actual directory census separately compares artifact-name set; last_file inode/link/size/hash must bind observed artifact records rather than trusting self-reported ino
No writes/subprocess/date/helper at module import or call; date/settlement/provenance and full five-part transaction remain parent external duties
No runtime/tests/compile/import until source review plus separate finite GO; all files exclusive-create, old ones unchanged
scope_boundary: No new scientific interface, no mutation of earlier contract or accepted source. A read refusal is fail closed and retains resource uncertainty; no caller can silently discard reader.report.
